zh.name: 配饰手持与佩戴特写
zh.summary: 用手持和佩戴近景讲清配饰大小与质感。
zh.useWhen: 适合帽子、眼镜等需要看实物大小和佩戴效果的配饰。
zh.instructions: 上传配饰手持照、佩戴照和细节，填写卖点。
zh.output: 配饰佩戴效果和细节图。

en.name: Handheld Accessories and Wearing Details
en.summary: Turn your product photos into a TikTok Shop carousel about handheld Accessories and Wearing Details.
en.useWhen: For hats, glasses, and accessories whose scale matters when worn.
en.instructions: Upload product and reference photos, then add verified details.
en.output: An editable TikTok Shop carousel with handheld Accessories and Wearing Details.
